rationale: A is better because it turns admin-defined fields into a metadata table plus JSONB rather than exposing general runtime DDL, yielding a safer, more scalable, and more actionable design. Its five tickets have clearer dependencies, acceptance criteria, transactional behavior, and edge-case protections such as refresh-token reuse detection and last-admin safeguards.
